subject: Quick thought on The Dentists at Ralston Square website
body: Hi Team, I always appreciate seeing practices like yours recognized as Omaha Magazine's Best Family Dentist for 18 consecutive years. While browsing your site to read up on your cosmetic and implant offerings across your four locations, I noticed a few technical items worth polishing. Specifically, some blog archives are currently listed as Uncategorized, and adding direct click-to-call phone anchors and streamlined booking CTAs right onto those service pages could help more families convert easily on mobile. Because I love the work Dr. Jay Samuelson and the team do, I took the liberty of rebuilding a clean, modern prototype for you. It features a streamlined layout, structured topical clusters for your blog content, and dedicated service sections. Feel free to check out the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x87938ddb6147a95d-0xb496c2b257c8c7c.vercel.app. If you'd like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I'd be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you're happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Cleaned up uncategorized blog tags into structured topical clusters
Standardized phone number anchors as direct tel: links across the contact sections
Added streamlined appointment booking calls-to-action directly below key content headings
